notes: Categorize by the main subject of the post, not its format: a chart about GPU prices is Hardware unless the visualization technique itself is what makes it interesting.
AI-generated images where the image is the point -> Art; posts about the model, technique, or tooling that made it -> AI.
GPU/CPU/silicon news and specs -> Hardware; programming GPUs (CUDA, shaders, rendering) -> Graphics.
Terminal, editor, and Linux desktop customization -> Dev.
Product launches with a technical deep-dive -> the technical category; funding or business angle -> Industry.
